persona.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
persona.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast / Modern Clean B2B SaaS (Linear, Stripe, Notion inspired)
persona.description: High-density, highly disciplined B2B SaaS platform design with neutral stone/zinc tones, crisp 1px borders, subtle ambient shadows, compact information-dense tables, and prominent multi-tenant organization context.

typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans or Work Sans
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono
typography.font_family_css: font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-heading: 'Cabinet Grotesk', 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

hierarchy.overline_label: text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500

color_palette.primary_button: bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white dark:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-200 dark:text-slate-900

status_badge_colors.critical_high_risk: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200 dark:bg-red-950/50 dark:text-red-300 dark:border-red-800/60
status_badge_colors.medium_warning: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800/60
status_badge_colors.low_info: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800/60
status_badge_colors.success_approved: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/60
status_badge_colors.in_review_neutral: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700

sidebar.style: fixed left-0 top-0 bottom-0 z-40 bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 border-r border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between
sidebar.client_selector: Prominent, un-missable tenant selector dropdown at top of sidebar with org logo avatar, environment badge (e.g. Production/Staging), tenant switcher modal/dropdown, and tenant role indicator (e.g., Super Admin, Client Read-Only).

header.style: h-14 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 sticky top-0 z-30 px-6 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Notifications popover with unread count badge

dashboard_grid.mode: MODE B: High Density Command-Center Grid
dashboard_grid.kpi_strip: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6
dashboard_grid.kpi_focus: Overdue Reviews, Open Findings, Significant Risks, Upcoming Reviews (Avoid compliance percentage gauges as centerpiece!)

tables_and_data_density.row_height: h-9 (36px compact mode) or h-10 for standard rows
features: Fixed sticky header with subtle bottom border
Inline quick edit dropdowns for status/owner/due date
Bulk row action bar (Assign, Review, Export, Delete)
Saved views bar (e.g. 'My Overdue Reviews', 'Critical Findings', 'All Risks')
Row click opens detail drawer / slide-over panel

record_detail_views.pattern: Slide-over drawer or tabbed full page detail with tabs: Overview, Workflow/Remediation, Evidence/Documents, Related Items, Comments, Activity History
record_detail_views.relationship_links: Clickable chips connecting Reviews -> Findings -> Remediation Tasks -> Risks -> Policies -> Vendors/Assets

components_and_ui.evidence_upload: Drag-and-drop zone with version history, file preview, uploader info, and approval status badge
components_and_ui.toasts: Use Sonner component at bottom-right for action feedback

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, tabs, tenant selectors, inputs, badges, and row links MUST include concise kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="org-selector-trigger", data-testid="reviews-table-row-1", data-testid="create-review-button").

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the React .js component structure under /app/frontend/src/.
Do not use generic centered or card-heavy Bootstrap layouts. Use Linear/Stripe-inspired compact borders, subtle background tints, and crisp typographic hierarchy.
Ensure tenant isolation and client context switcher is prominently visible in the persistent left sidebar.
Avoid making compliance percentage gauges the centerpiece of the dashboard. Focus on actionable items: Overdue Reviews, Open Findings, Significant Risks, Upcoming Reviews.
Every tabbed view or drawer MUST support responsive fallback for mobile viewport while maintaining high desktop data density.
Always use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for crisp B2B SaaS iconography.
